# Job Description - Application Architect

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Resources](../../README.md) • [Job Descriptions](../README.md)**

---

> **Position**: Application Architect
> **Department**: Enterprise Architecture Practice
> **Reports To**: Senior Enterprise Architect
> **Location**: Remote/Hybrid
> **Classification**: Full-time

---
page_texts.2:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#position-summary]

## Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Application Architect to join our Enterprise Architecture Practice (EAP) team. This role will design and oversee the architecture of complex healthcare applications within Gainwell Technologies' portfolio, ensuring application excellence, scalability, and alignment with enterprise architecture standards while delivering high-performance applications that meet business requirements.

---
page_texts.4:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#application-architecture-design]

### Application Architecture Design

- Design comprehensive application architectures for complex healthcare applications and systems
- Create detailed application specifications, interface designs, and implementation guidelines
- Develop application standards and patterns that guide software development across the organization
- Ensure application designs align with Enterprise Reference Architecture (ERA) principles
page_texts.5:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#application-integration--performance]

### Application Integration & Performance

- Design application integration architectures for healthcare ecosystem connectivity
- Create high-performance, scalable application solutions for large-scale healthcare data processing
- Design API architectures and microservices patterns for healthcare application interoperability
- Implement application solutions for real-time healthcare data processing and analytics
page_texts.6:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#development-leadership]

### Development Leadership

- Provide technical leadership and guidance to software development teams
- Lead application design reviews and code architecture assessments
- Mentor developers on application architecture principles and implementation best practices
- Drive adoption of modern development practices and emerging technologies
page_texts.7:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#technology-innovation]

### Technology Innovation

- Evaluate and recommend new technologies, frameworks, and development tools for applications
- Design proof-of-concept implementations for emerging healthcare application technologies
- Lead application technology research and development initiatives
- Support technical due diligence for application technology vendor evaluations
page_texts.8:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#quality--standards]

### Quality & Standards

- Establish application quality standards and development best practices
- Design testing strategies and quality assurance frameworks for applications
- Implement monitoring and observability solutions for application systems
- Support DevOps practices and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) for applications

---
page_texts.10:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#education]

### Education

- **Minimum**: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field
- **Preferred**: Master's degree in Computer Science or advanced technical field
page_texts.11:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#experience]

### Experience

- **Required**: 8+ years of experience in software development and application architecture
- **Required**: 4+ years of experience designing large-scale, distributed applications
- **Preferred**: 4+ years of experience in healthcare technology or regulated industry applications
page_texts.13:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#software-architecture]

#### Software Architecture

- Advanced software architecture patterns and design principles for applications
- Distributed application design and implementation
- Microservices architecture and API design for applications
- Event-driven architecture and messaging patterns for application integration
page_texts.14:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#programming--development]

#### Programming & Development

- Expert-level proficiency in multiple programming languages (Java, C#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript)
- Advanced understanding of software development frameworks and platforms
- Database design and optimization (SQL and NoSQL)
- Advanced knowledge of software development lifecycle and methodologies
page_texts.15:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#platform--infrastructure]

#### Platform & Infrastructure

- Cloud-native application development (AWS, Azure)
- Container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and application orchestration
- DevOps practices and CI/CD pipeline implementation for applications
- Performance optimization and application scalability techniques
page_texts.16:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#healthcare-technology]

#### Healthcare Technology

- Healthcare interoperability standards (X12 EDI, NCPDP, FHIR, HL7) for applications
- Healthcare data processing and analytics application platforms
- Understanding of healthcare compliance requirements (HIPAA, MITA) for applications
- Experience with healthcare application integration
page_texts.17:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#documentation--ai-tools]

#### Documentation & AI Tools

- Markdown and documentation-as-code practices for technical documentation
- Experience with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Amazon CodeWhisperer, etc.)
- Generative AI tools for architecture design, code generation, and problem-solving
- AI agents and automation tools for development and architecture workflows
page_texts.20:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#preferred]

#### Preferred

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Azure Solutions Architect
- Software architecture certifications (IASA, SEI)
- Programming language or platform-specific certifications

---
page_texts.22:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#specialized-technical-experience]

### Specialized Technical Experience

- Experience with healthcare-specific development frameworks and application platforms
- Knowledge of Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS) application implementation
- Understanding of real-time healthcare data processing and streaming applications
- Experience with AI/ML implementation for healthcare applications
- Experience with Generative AI integration into enterprise applications and platforms
page_texts.23:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#advanced-development-areas]

### Advanced Development Areas

- Experience with high-performance computing and parallel processing for applications
- Knowledge of blockchain technology implementation in applications
- Understanding of edge computing and IoT for healthcare applications
- Experience with advanced analytics and machine learning application platforms
page_texts.24:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#leadership--process]

### Leadership & Process

- Experience leading technical teams and application development projects
- Knowledge of agile development methodologies and practices for applications
- Understanding of technical project management and application delivery
- Experience with application architecture governance and standards

---
page_texts.26:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#technical-competencies]

### Technical Competencies

- **Application Design**: Expertise in designing complex, scalable application systems
- **Performance Engineering**: Advanced skills in application performance optimization
- **Integration Architecture**: Deep knowledge of application integration patterns and APIs
- **Technology Evaluation**: Ability to assess and select appropriate technologies and tools for applications
page_texts.27:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#technical-leadership--mentoring]

### Technical Leadership & Mentoring

- **Technical Mentoring**: Capability to guide and develop technical team members in application development
- **Code Quality**: Understanding of code quality standards and review processes for applications
- **Development Practices**: Knowledge of modern development practices and DevOps for applications
- **Innovation**: Ability to identify and implement emerging technologies in applications
page_texts.28:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#problem-solving]

### Problem Solving

- **Complex Problem Solving**: Skills in analyzing and solving complex application challenges
- **Root Cause Analysis**: Ability to identify and address application issues systematically
- **Performance Troubleshooting**: Expertise in diagnosing and resolving application performance issues
- **Technical Communication**: Ability to explain complex application concepts clearly

---
page_texts.30:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#technical-delivery]

### Technical Delivery

- Design and implement high-quality application architectures for healthcare systems
- Ensure application solutions meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements
- Support successful development and deployment of application solutions
- Maintain application architecture documentation and implementation guidelines
page_texts.31:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/application-architect.md#team-leadership--development]

### Team Leadership & Development

- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams on application architecture
- Drive adoption of application development best practices and standards
- Support technical skill development across the organization in application development
- Contribute to application architecture standards and patterns

---

_This job description is part of Gainwell's Enterprise Architecture Practice talent acquisition framework.
